items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: Yeah. He worked with us. Sails worked with us until we got on the boat.

ctx.x: Yeah. He worked with us. Sails worked with us until we got on the boat. That's where he got a job on the boat, and he never would come back anymore, you know? I mean, I don't even call it. I worked with many of them.
Sails was old enough to play with you in 1918 or so during the war?
